scope: Two owned visible-token RGB reconstruction objectives (masked_visible_tokens and visible_target), three seeds each, eight-epoch four-fit-video pretraining, followed by frozen-backbone CE+Triplet identity probes on the first legal outer fold. This is an offline crop-gallery diagnostic only; no native MOT, all-fold encoder replay, Dense-JEPA novelty or final-method claim.

fold_protocol.checkpoint_selection: fixed final epoch 8; no outer checkpoint or threshold selection

source_and_config.pretraining_source_scope: Owned canonical current-RGB visible-token reconstruction; no copied FishMAE code/weights, no official FishMAE/MAE reproduction, no external data.

storage.output_storage_policy: Full resumable scratch/checkpoints stayed on /tmp; only final encoder/probe checkpoint plus manifests copied to protected asset storage.

runtime_guards.gpu_policy: GPU1 was checked idle before each sequential run; GPU4-9 were not used.

interpretation.masked_visible_tokens: Three frozen probes remain around the frozen CLS reference: mean detector-gap25 Rank-1 57.302% ±0.572 sample SD versus 57.937%; seed1 matches the reference, seed0/2 are below it. mAP is higher but unknown-selected counts are 47/50/59 versus 42, so this is not a clean matched identity gain.
interpretation.visible_target: All three probes are below frozen CLS at detector gap25 (mean Rank-1 51.481% ±1.682 sample SD; 49.683/53.016/51.746%), and do not support a visible-target identity route.
interpretation.matched_control: The two objectives share the declared four-fit split, sampling/augmentation/update budget and frozen-head probe; lower visible-target retrieval and mixed masked results show reconstruction loss alone is insufficient evidence for identity improvement.
interpretation.native_or_novelty: No native MOT replay was run for these encoders; the crop-gallery producer is not wired into the native-coordinate replay. No Dense-JEPA, FishMAE, official reproduction or independent contribution credit is assigned.
interpretation.goal: This strengthens the negative/limited identity evidence while leaving the full EvidenceFishMOT goal IN_PROGRESS_UNACHIEVED. Remaining full-goal requirements are not silently discharged by this first-fold offline campaign.

limitations: One outer/inner fold only for this campaign; no all-sixfold encoder fitting or native replay.
Four fit-video unlabeled pool and inherited DINO foundation exposure remain internal-scope limitations.
Unknown-selected counts differ from the frozen reference; mAP comparisons must be read with those counts and support shown.
Full resumable scratch is transient on /tmp and is retained for this working session; final encoders/probe finals and exact hashes are stable on the protected asset mount.
The report does not claim official FishMAE, Dense-JEPA, external generalization, final combination or whole-raw FPS.
next_discriminating_work: Preserve this negative three-seed evidence in the final audit and do not select a lucky seed.
Only attempt native/all-fold integration if a lawful adapter can consume the encoder without changing proposal/history/evaluator semantics and while retaining the >=40 GiB guard.
Revisit final combination only when component evidence supplies independent same-input benefit; otherwise keep frozen FIFO as the strong reference.
